newsitem.title: USA: GTE unit to build Latam interent gateway.
newsitem.headline: GTE unit to build Latam interent gateway.

text.p: GTE Corp's CODETEL unit on Tuesday said it and CAIS Internet, a unit of CGX Communications, will build an Internet gateway to serve the Caribbean and Central and South America.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The Internet gateways, or network access points, connect national and regional Internet service providers to each other over high-speed links and switches.
The new regional Internet network access point will be called the Latin Internet Exchange, or LIX, and will be located in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic.
The LIX will be fully operational by June, the firm said.
CODETEL says it has begun seeking commitments from regional Internet service providers to connect to the new facility.
CODETEL is a telecommunications company in the Dominican Republic.
